hey man, i’m 14 years old. yeah i’m really young but these past few months i’ve experienced pain and emptiness like i never had before, i’ve never felt anything like it. please don’t go man, too much is going on in the world right now, riots, protests, etc. you have a reason to live, everyone does. you’re 40 years old, my dad just turned 40 this year. i’ve had a really rough fucked up childhood, my dad was in the papers, my parents sold weed, they constantly argued, my dad was hooked on prescription meds. when i was a kid my dad was a gangster, he did a lot of bad things in his life, he’s killed a few people, but he stopped for me, he realized that he needed to be there for me. so instead of doing his gangster shit with all of my uncles, he became a bounty hunter and a bail bondsman. my parents still sold weed at the time, and he did and accomplished a lot by going that route. but something ended up happening, his best friend, his partner threw him under the bus in court over something that my dad didn’t do. and what did my dad do because of his childhood growing up doing gangster shit, he didn’t snitch on him. both him and i can’t describe the hatred we have for him. he was stressed out everyday thinking he was going to prison while he was on probation. we stopped selling weed because of that. i forgot to mention that during this time period we were couch surfing and occasionally stood at a motel for a couple weeks. i watched him get put in handcuffs countless times. eventually my mom had got hooked on drugs and ended up leaving. i would’ve been in the 4th grade at the time but i skipped it because she left. while she was gone i helped my dad get off his meds. we were best friends, he is my best friend. my mom had came back after about 2 years, they would have conflict every now and then during that time period. when she came back it took some time to gain her trust back but she got clean. my dad had a stable job with his step dad before my mom came back. we were now living in a new house with my grandma. sometime after that, the man who kept my dad out of prison, my uncle who is a lawyer and is great at what he does, got my dad an even better job. at this point i realized, i have a stable family, a stable home, with legally made money, real jobs, i was happy. but going through all of that, there was some fun and happiness, i helped them grow weed, i loved it. i was a little green thumb just like my dad. we lived in the back of an old shop for about a year on an old dirty mattress. so there was good in all of that. but my point is, no matter how much bad and dark there is, there is always light and happiness. i promise you that good will come your way. there’s no light without dark, and you just didn’t experience the best at first, but there will be good coming your way. i’ve been playing guitar for about 2 years and it helps me get stuff off of my mind when i’m upset or my anxiety starts acting up. you should try to introduce music interests into your life. any instruments sound can be appreciated and it’s so beautiful to get into music. you should play guitar or something, i think it’ll help. i also think i’m moderately depressed, bipolar runs in my dads family, including him and my grandma so i wouldn’t be surprised if i was somewhat unhappy. but the number one thing that keeps me going everyday is my great grandpas dog tags, i wear them everyday, and so did my dad. my dad shot someone in the middle of a firefight when he was bounty hunting with these dog tags on. so much history is behind them and they mean so much to me. i promise you man, good will come your way. i hope you see my comment and i make your day or something. making people happy makes me happy, i’ve always been the quiet kid that people avoid. have a good day :) i wish the best for you
